title: Editorial
line: A magazine spread in motion: warm paper, huge serif display type that rises out of masked lines, hairline grids, one vermilion accent, hard cuts between spreads.
bestFor: anything that should feel considered, not techy

beats.visual: On warm paper, a vermilion rule draws across; ONE VIDEO. rises line by line out of masked baselines under a small folio.
Hard cut to the next spread: a huge serif 7 and 'posts this week'; seven day blocks fill vermilion one after another.

beats.say: From the edit you already made.
beats.visual: The spread rests; a one-line caption types in under the blocks; a slow push.
